Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Class McpResourceContents

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.McpResourceContents
public final class McpResourceContents extends Object
Revision-neutral resource payload, either inline text or a base64 blob.

Supersedes the wire-level ResourceContents dictionary and its two leaf types. Used both by McpContentBlock.resource(McpResourceContents) and by McpResourceOutcome.
